title: Smoothness is local on an open cover of the source
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $(U_a)_{a\in A}$ a family of open subschemes of $X$ whose union is $X$, with inclusion maps $j_a:U_a\to X$. Then $f$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] if and only if every composite $f\circ j_a:U_a\to Y$ is smooth. The index set $A$ may be empty, in which case the covering hypothesis implies $X=\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 01V6, label lemma-smooth-characterize, equivalence (1) and (3), taking the target cover to be the single open Y
